description: O’Neill takes command of Stargate Command while SG-1 faces the final convergence of the Goa’uld, Replicators and Jaffa rebellion. The struggle for Dakara reshapes the galaxy, and the team’s continuing search for Ancient technology leads to a dangerous trip into Earth’s past.

s08e01.description: With O’Neill frozen by Ancient knowledge and the Asgard unavailable, Carter and the team confront Ba’al while seeking a way to save Jack.

s08e02.description: O’Neill’s rescue, the Replicator threat and a Goa’uld power struggle converge as Stargate Command adjusts to a radically changed leadership.

s08e03.description: The spirit of Anubis moves from host to host inside Stargate Command, turning ordinary personnel into an escape route for the defeated System Lord.

s08e04.description: O’Neill faces his first major crisis as SGC commander when SG-1 disappears, Ba’al threatens the base and visiting dignitaries arrive at the worst possible time.

s08e05.description: Daniel becomes trapped on a world whose discovery of the Stargate has triggered religious and political upheaval and a devastating civil war.

s08e06.description: Teal’c enters an immersive combat simulation that adapts so aggressively to him that the program refuses to let its player leave.

s08e07.description: Teal’c moves off base and befriends a neighbor, only to become entangled in a violent local dispute that threatens his new civilian life.

s08e08.description: A powerful businessman publicly claims aliens exist and produces evidence of the Stargate, forcing the SGC to contain a disclosure it cannot simply deny.

s08e09.description: Jaffa refugees arrive at Stargate Command for a wedding that exposes tensions between Teal’c’s old family obligations and his new life.

s08e10.description: The Stargate vanishes from Earth, and SG-1 discovers that a covert organization is using stolen Asgard technology to wage its own war on the Goa’uld.

s08e11.description: A duplicate of Carter created by Fifth reaches Earth claiming to have escaped the Replicators, but her real purpose threatens both SG-1 and the galaxy.

s08e12.description: Vala hijacks Prometheus using stolen armor, forcing Daniel into an uneasy partnership as the ship becomes tangled in an alien political conflict.

s08e13.description: SG-1 finds Maybourne living comfortably as a king whose predictions come from Ancient records, until one prophecy announces an approaching disaster.

s08e14.description: Goa’uld infiltration reaches Earth’s governments, pushing SG-1 and Russian allies into a race to prevent political manipulation from becoming global catastrophe.

s08e15.description: An Indiana barber realizes that the visions inspiring his stories are actually fragments of O’Neill’s experiences leaking through an Ancient communication device.

s08e16.description: The Replicators launch a galaxy-wide offensive as Ba’al and the System Lords battle for survival, forcing SG-1 to consider using an Ancient superweapon.

s08e17.description: SG-1 attempts to activate the Dakara weapon against every Replicator in the galaxy while the Jaffa rebellion seizes its chance to overthrow Goa’uld rule.

s08e18.description: Daniel faces Oma and Anubis on a higher plane while Carter, O’Neill and Teal’c deal with the aftermath of the Goa’uld empire’s collapse.

s08e19.description: SG-1 travels to ancient Egypt to recover a ZPM from Ra, but a small change strands the team in the past and rewrites the present.

s08e20.description: An alternate SG-1 follows clues left by their stranded counterparts and tries to repair a timeline where the Stargate program never existed.
